title: Leftward clock sweep on a marked cell
statement: Let $S$ be a deterministic machine, $A$ a nondeterministic machine, and $x$ a Boolean input word; let $m\in\mathbb N$, let $b$ be a choice bit, and choose an input-head position, work-tape contents and head positions for both machines, and an integer $z$. If the yard tape contains true at cell $z$, then one host-machine step in phase $p0$ moves the input head left with clamping, advances each of $A$’s work-tape heads by one, moves the yard-tape head from $z$ to $z-1$, and leaves the phase, all tape contents, the $S$ work-tape head positions, and the output unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a deterministic machine over Boolean symbols
$A$ is a nondeterministic machine over Boolean symbols
$sT$ and $aT$ specify Boolean work-tape contents for $S$ and $A$
$sP$ and $aP$ specify integer work-tape head positions for $S$ and $A$
The yard tape contains true at cell $z$
